title: Future of Insurance
primary_theme: InsurTech can restore insurance to its customer promise
secondary_themes: Female founders in FinTech and insurance
founder_lessons: Start from a clean-sheet customer experience rather than automating the incumbent workflow as-is.
Understand that large insurance companies may spend heavily on IT without moving the ball effectively.
Build support structures that connect startups with carriers and mentors in the insurance ecosystem.
Increase representation in FinTech and InsurTech so the builders better match the market they serve.
notable_quotes: insurtech is necessary for the insurance industry to realize its promise.
the promise of insurance is to bring people back to the position that they were in prior to a calamity happening
the purpose of it is really to help support female founders that want to come into finance and insurance and get the resources and support that they need.
